def produce(self, seed, context):
    a = torch.sin(seed)
    b = torch.cos(a)
    c = torch.relu(b)
    d = torch.tanh(c)
    e = torch.sin(d)
    f = torch.cos(e)
    return torch.sigmoid(f + context) * (f * context)

def receive(self, signal, context, previous):
    a = torch.cos(signal)
    b = torch.sin(a)
    c = torch.tanh(b)
    d = torch.relu(c)
    e = torch.sin(d)
    f = torch.cos(e)
    return torch.tanh(f * context + previous) * torch.cos(f - context)
return torch.tanh(f * context + previous) * torch.cos(f - context)
